description: Point-in-time trailing-twelve-month (TTM) financials for a company on a historical date, safe for backtesting: every figure comes from SEC filings accepted on or before `as_of_date`, so no later information leaks in. TTM sums the four most recent standalone quarters (or uses the latest fiscal-year filing when no quarterly series exists). Returns TTM revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, EBITDA, net_income, OCF, CapEx, FCF; a balance-sheet snapshot (diluted shares, cash, debt, net debt, book equity); and TTM gross, operating and net margins. No share price and no price-based multiple is returned: for a multiple on a price the user gave you, use `compute_price_multiples`; for the price-free reference values (graham_number, ncav_per_share) use `get_valuation_metrics`. Use for historical fundamentals screens, backtest entry-point financials and peak/trough forensics. Plan: Pro (most recent 15 years) or Institutional (back to 1993); on a free plan it returns ENTITLEMENT_DENIED before any read.

as_of_date.description: The historical date for the snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD). Only filings accepted on or before this date are read. Use a recent date for the latest figures, or any date back to 1993 (subject to your plan's history window) for the figures as they were observable then.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT — or a CIK (SEC identifier), e.g. '0000320193'.

name: get_pit_valuation_ratios

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

reporting_currency.description: ISO currency of every monetary financial field (read from the facts' units).

title: Point-in-Time TTM Financials
